problem_text:
A logistics firm must coordinate the dispatch of a single vehicle to four distinct warehouses for inventory audits.

The travel times between warehouses, measured in minutes, are as follows:
* Warehouse Alpha to Beta: 76.0 minutes
* Warehouse Alpha to Gamma: 37.2 minutes
* Warehouse Alpha to Delta: 51.5 minutes
* Warehouse Beta to Gamma: 107.2 minutes
* Warehouse Beta to Delta: 112.7 minutes
* Warehouse Gamma to Delta: 66.9 minutes

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient inspection circuit, wherein the vehicle must arrive at each warehouse precisely one time before concluding its tour back at the initial departure point.
